messages.text: Hi there! 😊  Is this room available for couples? My partner and I are very interested in the room.  We’re both clean, respectful, and easy-going, and we’re looking for a quiet and comfortable place to live.  If we’re approved after the inspection, we were hoping to move in on either April 7 or April 8.  Would it be possible to arrange an inspection? We’re only available on Mondays to Wednesdays, sorry about the limited availability.  Thank you so much! 😊
Hi Riege Christian! We have a room viewing at 606 Vulture St E, East Brisbane tonight Wednesday 11 March at 6pm. Would you like to come? 😊
